what: How often the human-chosen option survives a cut to MAG's top k. The metric for MAG as a PRUNER feeding a search, as opposed to top-1 accuracy which is the metric for MAG as a decider.
caveat: The held-out split is hash(game) % 5, deterministic and inspected across many refits, so it is a validation set in practice rather than an untouched holdout. Recall here is measured against HUMAN choices, which is not the same as against the objectively best move — a human shortlist ceiling, not a game-theoretic one.
